aboutTitle:

Purpose in every branch.
aboutBody: I’m Pedro Eduardo Dall’Agnol, a Brazilian developer based in Bragança, Portugal. I study Systems Analysis and Development at UFPR and am undertaking academic mobility in Computer Engineering at IPB in 2026–2027.
aboutBody2: My work connects front-end and back-end development, software analysis, database modelling and network administration. I enjoy turning complex problems into clear, usable solutions.
aboutBody3: Yggdrasil, the tree of life in Norse mythology, inspires this portfolio: different branches, shared foundations. A personal way to represent how design, code and infrastructure connect.

storyLabel: The moons of Varnor · A tale by Pedro Dall’Agnol
story1Title: Every journey begins with a spark.
story1Body: In the cold of Winholm, an elderly guardian warmed the night with a story. Around the fire, the children listened: why did two moons chase each other across the sky?
story2Title: A little honey. An endless chase.
story2Body: Rrenner stole honey for her sister Êmer. The bees gave chase. Êmer ran to save her; Rrenner mistook care for punishment. They ran so far that they reached the stars.
story3Body: They became moons: Êmer, the larger; Rrenner, the smaller. Drops of honey became trails of light. But Tarik wanted that light for himself alone.
story4Title: Even light can be held captive.
story4Body: Desire turned Tarik into a dragon. He wrapped his body around the sisters and darkened the world. Wanting to possess everything, he found himself alone in the dark.
story5Title: A thread of light breaks the night.
story5Body: A rider on a horse of stardust crossed the void. A lance of light broke the dragon’s embrace. The sisters were free to run again.
story6Title: A shadow is never the whole story.
story6Body: Tarik remained bound to their orbits. As he passes, his body hides part of each moon: that is how their phases were born. The elderly woman smiled: ‘Light lives when it can be shared.’
originBody: My journey in technology began in 2020, exploring programming and the foundations of web development. Curiosity became a habit of building, testing and learning.
learningBody: Algorithms, data structures and object-oriented programming deepened my understanding of software. Databases, networks and systems added new layers to that foundation.
